name: Auto-Save Value
description: @AUTOSAVE action tags to trigger automatic saving of field values during data entry and/or on survey forms, plus an optional offline layer for data entry forms that keeps an encrypted copy of the form on the device and retries saves when the connection returns. Adapted from Auto-Save Value by Luke Stevens, Murdoch Children's Research Institute; the action-tag half is his work.

action-tags.description: Tag a text field with @AUTOSAVE to have the value saved automatically after its value is updated.
As @AUTOSAVE, but in data entry mode only, not in survey mode.
As @AUTOSAVE, but in survey mode only, not in data entry mode.
As @AUTOSAVE-FORM, but suppress the field's save icon where in data entry mode it would normally be shown.
As @AUTOSAVE-SURVEY, but show the field's save icon where in survey mode it would normally be suppressed.

project-settings.name:
Offline layer
Everything below is separate from the @AUTOSAVE action tags, which need no configuration. Choose which instruments to protect; "all" includes instruments added later. Until a choice is made the offline layer does nothing, which is deliberate: it should not start writing to a form nobody asked it to. On data entry forms it also saves in the background; on survey pages it holds the page on the device and offers it back after a reload, nothing more.
Discard on-device drafts older than this many hours (default 12)

Text for "reason for change" (default is "auto_save_value")
Used by both layers. Neither can stop and ask a human for a reason, so the same text is logged every time. If that is not acceptable for your audit trail, do not enable this module on that project.
